parts.text: I work at the airspace desk keeping the shared picture of the airspace, which includes the network of flight corridors between sites, the zones that group them, and the closures announced by the authorities. When a closure is entered, I want to know how much disruption it caused across customers. I support the customer companies on the platform, which currently include a parcel delivery firm, an infrastructure inspection firm, and a regional hospital logistics firm, with others expected to join.
